title: Monogram — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Monogram.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Statement-Making Performance." Luxury tier. Monogram is GE Appliances luxury brand — professional-grade performance in a fully customizable package. Reverse air convection ensures even cooking, and the Advantium speedcook oven uses halogen, microwave, and convection simultaneously. Monogram competes directly with Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Thermador at a slightly lower price point with strong smart home integration.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Luxury kitchen builds where the customer wants GE service and support. Competing against Sub-Zero/Wolf on price. Connected luxury kitchen.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Monogram:

• Reverse air convection — fan reverses direction for perfectly even cooking

• Advantium speedcook oven cooks up to 8x faster using three heat technologies

• Statement hardware collection customizes the look — like Cafe but at luxury tier

• Competes with Wolf/Thermador but with better smart home integration

• GE service network — easier to get serviced than European luxury brands
